Ensemble Aggregation of Geomorphon Classifications

Source: R/sweep.R
geomorphon_ensemble.Rd

Computes cell-wise ensemble summaries across parameter sweep runs, supporting deterministic modal classification and per-class proportion layers.

Usage

geomorphon_ensemble(
  sweep_obj,
  method = c("modal", "proportions"),
  form = NULL,
  classes = NULL,
  ties = "lowest",
  ...
)

Arguments

sweep_obj

An object of class geomorphon_sweep, a list of SpatRaster objects, or a multi-layer SpatRaster representing runs of a parameter sweep.

method

character. Aggregation method: "modal" (default) computes the modal landform class per cell; "proportions" computes per-class proportions across non-NA runs.

form

character or numeric. Which form taxonomy to aggregate when multiple exist in sweep_obj (e.g. "forms10", "forms6", "forms5", "forms4"). Defaults to the first or only form available.

classes

integer or character vector. Which landform classes to compute proportions for when method = "proportions". Defaults to NULL, which evaluates all reachable classes for form (10 for forms10, 6 for forms6, 5 for forms5, 4 for forms4), matching geomorphon_categories().

ties

character. Tie-breaking rule for method = "modal". Passed to terra::modal(), default is "lowest" for deterministic tie-breaking.

...

Additional arguments passed to methods.

Value

A SpatRaster (or matrix / list of matrices) containing the aggregated ensemble. For method = "modal", returns a single layer with geomorphon factor levels and color table applied. For method = "proportions", returns multi-layer proportions named by class.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
library(terra)
data("salton", package = "rgeomorphon")
dem <- rast(salton)
crs(dem) <- attr(salton, "crs")
ext(dem) <- attr(salton, "extent")

grid <- data.frame(search = c(3, 5), skip = c(0, 1))
sw <- geomorphon_sweep(dem, param_grid = grid, forms = "forms10")

ens_mode <- geomorphon_ensemble(sw, method = "modal")
ens_prop <- geomorphon_ensemble(sw, method = "proportions")
} # }
